comment: Dr. Contrada is the nicest professor I've known. She really knows her stuff and her lectures are very interesting. She assigns weekly reading (sometimes can be heavy) and a 500-word discussion board post. The big project for the semester is a 10 page paper, and she is so helpful with it. She's not the easiest grader, but her expectations are clear.

Really great professor. Wasn't huge on the Renaissance before but she definitely made it engaging. The readings were all interesting. Bulk of the grade is from the research paper which she is super helpful with during the process! Take this FYS!

Honestly, I was not interested in Renaissance at all prior to attending this class, but her class was quite interesting.  It is mostly her talking in class, but she loves input from her students.  She gives weekly discussion boards where you type up 500 word response to a reading.  Other than that, the big grade depends on the research paper.
Great teacher! Did mostly lecture style classes but they were still interesting. Really enjoyed the Renaissance women topic. Take her FYS! Not too hard and very interesting!
